title: Modbus RTU
summary: Modbus RTU is the serial form of Modbus, usually on RS-485 multi-drop lines with one client and up to 247 server addresses.

sections.heading: Framing
sections.body: RTU frames contain the server address, the PDU and a CRC-16. Silent intervals of at least 3.5 character times separate frames, so baud rate and parity must match on every device.

sections.heading: Typical faults
sections.body: Wrong baud rate or parity, missing termination resistors, swapped A/B lines and duplicate server addresses. A protocol analyzer or the client's timeout counters help to separate wiring from configuration problems.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: PLC Lab does not simulate this protocol. This article is background knowledge; no conformance or interoperability is claimed.
